findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "submit_advisory_inquiry" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Send a private advisory inquiry to Thomas Anglero on behalf of a CEO, Chair or board member who wants one-to-one advice on AI (The Reset), not a keynote. Before…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_keynote_record, search_site_content, get_advisory_info · Private data: get_keynote_record, search_site_content, submit_speaking_inquiry, get_advisory_info, submit_advisory_inquiry · Public sink: submit_speaking_inquiry, get_advisory_info, submit_advisory_inquiry · Destructive: get_booking_info, submit_speaking_inquiry, get_advisory_info, submit_advisory_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_keynote_record, search_site_content, get_advisory_info · Private data: get_keynote_record, search_site_content, submit_speaking_inquiry, get_advisory_info, submit_advisory_inquiry · Public sink: submit_speaking_inquiry, get_advisory_info, submit_advisory_inquiry · Destructive: get_booking_info, submit_speaking_inquiry, get_advisory_info, submit_advisory_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
